Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) just had their share rating of a ‘Buy’ issued by research analysts at Guggenheim, who now has a $215.0000 PT on the $950.15 billion market cap company or a 11.22 % upside potential. This key information was revealed in an analyst note on 5 June. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Ratings Coverage
Among 35 analysts covering Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 18 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 17 Hold. Therefore 51% are positive. Apple has $235 highest and $157 lowest target. $197.12’s average target is 1.97% above currents $193.31 stock price. Apple had 82 analyst reports since December 7, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was downgraded by Stifel Nicolaus to “Hold” on Wednesday, March 7. Piper Jaffray maintained the shares of AAPL in report on Friday, January 12 with “Buy” rating. On Tuesday, December 19 the stock rating was downgraded by Nomura to “Hold”. The stock has “Buy” rating by RBC Capital Markets on Wednesday, March 28. BMO Capital Markets maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Monday, December 18 report. Bank of America maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on Monday, March 5 with “Buy” rating. The firm has “Buy” rating by Canaccord Genuity given on Tuesday, January 23. The rating was maintained by Oppenheimer with “Hold” on Monday, April 30. The rating was maintained by UBS with “Buy” on Tuesday, April 24. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, January 18 by Mizuho.
The stock increased 0.77% or $1.48 during the last trading session, reaching $193.31. About 19.54M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 earnings per share, up 31.14 % or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76 billion for 22.07 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78 % negative EPS growth.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $950.15 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 18.7 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
